digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI test workflow (macOS pytest cell coverage)
propositions: The macOS pytest cell is the critical path of the Verified gate and its --cov default-suite step dominates job duration while nothing consumes the macOS coverage number.
Coverage flags are made conditional on matrix OS so ubuntu cells keep --cov but macOS cells run without it, preserving the identical test selection.
The coverage floor fail_under=70 remains enforced by the three ubuntu cells running the same test selection, so no coverage is lost.
The workflow expression must place the empty branch in the || slot because GitHub Actions treats empty string as falsy, otherwise coverage would still be collected on both platforms.
The Verified gate cannot exercise a change to workflow files because workflow_dispatch resolves a './' reusable from the default branch, not the patchset, so measurement is post-merge only.
Expected macOS speedup is small (~0.8 min off ~18.6m) since coverage.py overhead measured at about +5.1%.
